Crop Science and Agronomy.Crop Physiology and Productivity: Field and controlled-environment experiments measuring growth, photosynthesis, yield components, and responses to abiotic stresses (drought, heat, CO₂).
Crop Science and Agronomy.Cropping Systems and Management: Long-term and replicated field trials comparing rotations, tillage, cover crops, nutrient management, and regenerative practices for productivity and resilience.
Crop Science and Agronomy.Soil Crop Interactions: Empirical studies on root architecture, nutrient uptake, rhizosphere processes, and how soil treatments affect crop performance.

Plant Breeding Genetics and Genomics.Conventional and Quantitative Breeding: Multi-location field trials, pedigree and hybrid evaluation, phenotypic selection trials, and varietal release experiments.
Plant Breeding Genetics and Genomics.Genomics-enabled breeding and Genome-Wid: Association/marker-assisted selection experiments, genomic prediction validated with field/greenhouse trials, and performance benchmarking.
Plant Breeding Genetics and Genomics.Gene Editing and Transgenic evaluation: Containment/greenhouse and field trials assessing CRISPR/Cas or transgenic lines for trait performance, stability, and regulatory data collection.
Plant Breeding Genetics and Genomics.Phenotyping and Genome-to-Phenome integr: High-throughput phenotyping experiments linking genomic variation to measured traits under controlled and field conditions.

Plant Physiology and Biochemistry.Abiotic Stress Biology: Controlled environment and field experiments probing physiological/biochemical responses to drought, salinity, temperature extremes, and hypoxia.
Plant Physiology and Biochemistry.Photosynthesis and carbon partitioning: Gas-exchange, fluorescence, isotopic and lab assays to quantify photosynthetic performance, respiration, and carbon allocation.
Plant Physiology and Biochemistry.Root Biology and Rhizosphere: Rhizotron, root imaging, exudate chemistry, and microcosm experiments studying root growth, signaling, and nutrient acquisition.

Plant Pathology and Plant Disease.Pathogen Biology and Epidemiology: Inoculation trials, host range studies, field disease surveys, and epidemiological field experiments to quantify spread and impact.
Plant Pathology and Plant Disease.Disease Resistance screening: Greenhouse and field screening trials of germplasm, fungicide/biocontrol efficacy tests, and resistance durability studies.
Plant Pathology and Plant Disease.Phytopathogen detection and diagnostics: Experimental validation of molecular diagnostics, remote sensing for disease detection, and surveillance field trials.

Entomology and Pest Management.Insect Ecology and population dynamics: Field trapping, mark-recapture, and cage experiments measuring life-history, dispersal, and pest pressure.
Entomology and Pest Management.Integrated Pest Management and biocontro: Field and greenhouse trials testing cultural, biological, chemical, and behavioral control strategies and their interactions.
Entomology and Pest Management.Insecticide Efficacy and resistance moni: Dose-response bioassays, resistance allele surveys, and applied field efficacy trials.

Weed Science.Weed Ecology and Competition: Field experiments quantifying crop-weed competition, emergence timing, and ecological interactions under management regimes.
Weed Science.Herbicide Efficacy and resistance: Greenhouse/field dose trials, resistance diagnostics, and stewardship experiments for herbicide rotation/mixtures.
Weed Science.Nonchemical weed management: Studies on cover crops, tillage, mulching, and mechanical control effectiveness across environments.

Soil Science and Soil Health.Soil physics and hydrology: Field and lab measurements of infiltration, water retention, evaporation, and instrumentation/lysimeter experiments.
Soil Science and Soil Health.Soil chemistry and nutrient cycling: Experiments on nutrient transformations, fertilizer trials, isotopic tracer studies, and greenhouse leaching tests.
Soil Science and Soil Health.Soil microbiology and microbiomes: Laboratory microcosms and field manipulations to test microbial community effects on nutrient availability, disease suppression, and carbon dynamics.

Agroecology and Sustainable Agriculture.Agroecosystem dynamics and biodiversity: Field experiments assessing biodiversity effects, pollinator/predator services, and multifunctional landscape practices.
Agroecology and Sustainable Agriculture.Climate-Smart and resilient practices: On-farm and experimental-station trials testing mitigation/adaptation practices (e.g., cover crops, altered planting dates, carbon management).
Agroecology and Sustainable Agriculture.Socio-ecological field trials: Participatory experiments and on-farm trials that combine agronomic measurements with social uptake and economic outcomes.

Horticulture and protected culture.Controlled Environment and Greenhouse Cr: Controlled-environment trials on lighting, CO₂, substrate, and nutrient solutions for vegetables, ornamentals, and herbs.
Horticulture and protected culture.Postharvest physiology and storage: Experiments on respiration, ripening, storage protocols, cold chain trials, and shelf-life extension techniques.
Horticulture and protected culture.Fruit and vegetable production science: Field and orchard trials on pruning, training, cultivar evaluation, and pest/disease management tailored to horticultural crops.

Irrigation and water management.Irrigation technology and scheduling: Field experiments comparing irrigation systems, sensor-driven scheduling, deficit irrigation trials, and efficiency measurements.
Irrigation and water management.Water quality and salinity management: Mesocosm and field trials testing saline water impacts, remediation, and crop tolerance screening.

Precision Agriculture and Digital Agrono.Remote sensing and phenotyping: UAV/satellite and proximal sensing experiments for biomass, stress detection, and high-throughput trait measurement validated with ground truthing.
Precision Agriculture and Digital Agrono.Decision support and sensor validation: Field trials validating soil moisture, nutrient, and plant sensors and decision systems for management interventions.
Precision Agriculture and Digital Agrono.Robotics and automation in field trials: Experimental deployments of autonomous vehicles/robotic platforms for planting, scouting, and targeted treatment applications.

Plant-Microbe and Symbiosis research.Beneficial microbe inoculants: Greenhouse and field tests of microbial inoculants (PGPR, mycorrhizae) for yield, stress tolerance, and nutrient use efficiency.
Plant-Microbe and Symbiosis research.Pathobiome and microbiome manipulation: Experimental manipulation of microbiomes to study disease suppression, nutrient cycling, and host health outcomes.

Food Safety and Postharvest.Pathogen survival and contamination cont: Laboratory and processing-line experiments on pathogen survival, mitigation treatments, and sanitation efficacy.
Food Safety and Postharvest.Cold chain and storage trials: Empirical testing of storage regimes, packaging technologies, and transport conditions to reduce spoilage and maintain quality.

Agricultural Economics and on-farm exper.On-farm trial design and adoption studie: Randomized block and on-farm replicated trials measuring yield, input use, and farmer adoption under real-world conditions.
Agricultural Economics and on-farm exper.Technology evaluation and cost-benefit f: Empirical economic experiments assessing profitability and risk of management changes or new varietals.

Agri-biotechnology and synthetic biology.Biotech trait evaluation: Greenhouse and field trials assessing engineered traits for stress tolerance, nutritional enhancement, or production traits.
Agri-biotechnology and synthetic biology.Bio-based products testing: Experimental validation of biofertilizers, biopesticides, and plant-derived industrial products in lab and field settings.

Postharvest and value-chain processing r.Processing technologies and quality asse: Pilot-scale experimental evaluations of drying, milling, fermentation, and other processing steps and their effects on quality and safety.
Postharvest and value-chain processing r.Shelf-life interventions and supply chai: Intervention trials across storage, transport, and retail stages measuring losses and consumer-relevant quality attributes.

Controlled environment and vertical farm.Lighting and spectral optimization exper: Growth chamber and greenhouse studies testing spectral recipes, photoperiod, and light intensity effects on yield and quality.
Controlled environment and vertical farm.Systems integration and resource efficie: Experimental life-cycle and operational trials measuring energy, water, and nutrient efficiency of vertical/controlled systems.

Instrumentation and method development.Sensor development and validation: Laboratory and in-field calibration/validation experiments for novel sensors (spectral, chemical, robotic).
Instrumentation and method development.High-throughput methods and protocols: Development and benchmarking of experimental protocols for phenotyping, sample processing, and automated assays.

Plant conservation and plant biogeograph.Ex situ and in situ conservation experim: Empirical trials for seed banking viability, restoration plantings, and assisted migration experiments in field plots.
Plant conservation and plant biogeograph.Trait-based and range shift field studie: Manipulative field experiments testing species performance under simulated climate or land-use change.
